text:
Lena Ortiz: Hi team started today. Quick question: my personal iPad won't enroll in the company MDM (keeps failing at "device check"). Can I still use it for Slack or do I need a company device? Also the training portal says I'm not enrolled for the security modules even though I received a phishing sim email. Who should I contact?

Marco Silva: welcome Lena! :tada: You can use Slack on a personal iPad via the browser or the app with SSO, but we prefer not to put personal devices into MDM. Requirements: device passcode, disk encryption, and a screen lock timeout. No storing of customer PII on personal devices. If you need apps that require MDM (VPN, corp SSO for certain apps) you'll need manager approval.

Lena Ortiz: got it. The portal shows "pending" for "New Hire Security Basics" and I have a ticket `IT-54321` opened by the device enrollment flow. Any idea ETA on that?

IT Service: Update on `IT-54321`: Tier 1 looked and MDM rejected due to missing UDID during enrollment. If this is a personal device, we need signed manager approval per policy (see sec 3.2) to proceed. If you want to avoid MDM, use web Slack and mark the ticket as "personal-device exception"; ETA 1 business day for updating the record.

Priya Kapoor: FWIW phishing sims for new cohorts run on the first Thursday after your start date. If you already got one, that's likely a cohort scheduling overlap you'll get feedback and a short micro-training if you click a test link. Personal-device exception form: https://redwood-internal.kb/onboarding/personal-device-exception  (fill and cc your manager).

DevOps-bot: Security orientation assigned: "New Hire Security Basics" -> Lena Ortiz. Due date: 2025-05-02. Link: https://training.redwood-internal/learn/nh-security-basics

Lena Ortiz: thanks all. I'll use browser Slack for now and ask Jake to sign the exception if we need MDM. @Jake Brown can you approve if I request it?

Jake Brown: Happy to review, Lena. Ping me the form and I'll sign if there's a justified need.

Marco Silva: If you ever need a short-term workaround for Duo, we can request a 24-hour device bypass with a security justification, but that requires a ticket to security.

Lena Ortiz: Not necessary today. I'll close `IT-54321` once the portal updates and follow the exception flow if needed. Appreciate the quick responses :thumbsup:
